q.q: A man walks 4 m towards the west. He turns right. Then he walks 24 m. He turns right. Then he walks 3 m. He turns right. Then he walks 24 m. He turns right. Then he walks 12 m. How far is he from the starting point, and in which direction (from the starting point) is he now?
q.e: Net displacement is 13 m west and 0 m south; distance = √(13² + 0²) = 13 m.

q.q: Find the next term of the series: 5, 15, 8, 10, 11, ?
q.e: Rule: two interleaved series: +3 on the odd places and −5 on the even places. The next term is 5.

q.q: Sara is the daughter of Nida. Nida is the wife of Jamil. Jamil is the brother of Naveed. How is Sara related to Naveed?
q.e: Work through the chain link by link, assuming the usual convention that a couple's children are common to both.

q.q: 6 persons Hina, Kamran, Mariam, Omar, Rabia, Sadia live on 6 different floors of a building, numbered 1 (ground) to 6 (top), one person per floor. Hina lives on the floor immediately below Rabia. Kamran lives on the floor immediately below Omar. Sadia lives neither on the ground floor nor on the top floor. Omar lives neither on the ground floor nor on the top floor. Omar lives on a lower floor than Mariam. Rabia lives on a lower floor than Omar. Sadia lives on a lower floor than Kamran. Who lives on floor 6?
q.e: Place the definite clues first (immediate neighbours, ends), then use the 'between' and 'left of' clues to fix the rest; the arrangement is unique.
